review_scope: All 42 pages textually reconciled; 35 non-table pages match the source token-for-token after reviewed normalization. Seven table-bearing pages manually compared at individual-page resolution. Remaining layouts inspected in contact sheets; this is not a claim of line-by-line visual review of all prose.
review_notes: Restore 202 encoding glyphs, a cross-page bank table (two grids), four numerical tables and all 16 body superscript references, including the repeated 7.
Preserve printed numeric inconsistencies, all example placeholders, footnote text, historical institution names and original footer numbers.
Residual heuristic flags concern wide tables, long arithmetic expressions/URL and repeated source text. Do not remove these source passages to satisfy a scanner.
Assistant source review only: owner approval, extraction provenance review and governed publication still required. No signature, registry, seed or active release changed.
